status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: The branch on the remote at the commit the quality evaluation scored, the change shown working above its own tests, and a draft pull request open with CI green on its head — or CI's not running recorded on it — whose body lets the operator decide on it.

base.note: the branch the pull request is to merge into; not given, the remote's default branch

tool_requests.note: Besides the criteria, the PR body owes the operator the tool requests of every run (§5.3) and the recommendations deferred or separated. Each path is one run's tool-requests.json.

deferred.note: a JSON array of the recommendations deferred or separated, each {subject, finding, disposition}: the disposition is the issue that takes it (#<n>, or <owner>/<repo>#<n>) or the gap stated in one line

checks.note: the head's checks are all green, or the body records that no CI ran with the marker line

integration.note: how the change was shown working above its own tests, and what that showed

ci_failure.note: Written when a CI check failed: the failing check, the first failing assertion or error, where the fix that clears it is made, and the grounds for that judgment (docs/units/delivery.md > CI failure).
